teams.detail: On the All-Star break after beating Tampa Bay 8-2 last Sunday behind a Randy Arozarena three-run homer. Sit 2nd in the AL West, one game behind Texas (49-47), and hold a wild-card spot. Return to open the second half Friday vs. the Giants at T-Mobile Park.

Close out 2026 Summer League tonight against Phoenix (6 PM ET, ESPNU) after a 101-93 loss to the 76ers in their opener. No. 17 pick Ebuka Okorie (ex-Stanford) has been the team's top scorer through the tournament. Detroit also acquired Taurean Prince and Gary Harris from Milwaukee for Caris LeVert this month.

The Paul Allen Estate's agreement to sell the franchise to a Khosla family-led group for an NFL-record $9.6 billion still needs ratification from at least 24 of the other 31 owners. Defending Super Bowl champs return 20 of 22 starters; training camp opens July 25 in Renton, with Football Fest Aug. 8 at Lumen Field.

Landed a 4-star cornerback commitment, the class's highest-rated pledge to date, while still chasing a second corner and O-line help. RB Jordan Washington is targeting a late-July return from a spring injury ahead of fall camp. Season opens Sept. 5 vs. Washington State (Apple Cup).

Danny Sprinkle is rebuilding through the transfer portal and overseas recruiting after losing Zoom Diallo to the portal. F Hannes Steinbach, taken 14th overall by Charlotte in the 2026 NBA Draft, remains the program's top recent NBA export.

headlines.headline: Texas lands No. 1 prospect Marcus Spears Jr. in surprise reclassification
headlines.detail: Marcus Spears Jr., ranked the No. 1 prospect in the 2027 class, reclassified up and committed to Texas, giving the Longhorns a top-five 2026 class. More than 2,700 players moved through the transfer portal in the two-week window after the national title game.

headlines.headline: 76ers push LeBron pitch into week two of free agency
headlines.detail: Philadelphia is leaning on Tyrese Maxey, Joel Embiid and Jaylen Brown to recruit LeBron James as his free agency search stretches into a second week. The Kawhi Leonard trade to Toronto remains on hold pending the NBA's outside-counsel investigation, and the Wizards hold the No. 1 pick in the 2026 draft.

headlines.headline: Packers lock up Christian Watson with $110.5M extension
headlines.detail: Green Bay signed WR Christian Watson to a four-year, $110.5 million extension with a $31 million signing bonus ahead of training camp, which opens for most veterans league-wide July 24. Titans DT Jeffery Simmons also landed a deal making him the highest-paid interior defender in league history.

headlines.headline: ACC and Mountain West open media days as Michigan probe looms
headlines.detail: The ACC's three-day Football Kickoff began today in Charlotte with Florida State, Miami, NC State, Stanford and Virginia represented, while Mountain West media days run through Thursday in Las Vegas. Michigan's board of regents is reviewing a $12 million outside probe into the athletic department's culture.
